description:
You are an engineering manager at DevLabs. The Phoenix E-Commerce Platform v1.0 Launch is 45 days away and your team has raised concerns that release-critical issues are not being managed properly.

Your job is to perform a release-blocking triage on the Phoenix E-Commerce Platform project:

1. Review all issues targeted at the 'v1.0 Launch' milestone. For every open issue (not Closed, not Resolved) that has priority 'Urgent' or 'Immediate', add a comment containing the exact text 'RELEASE BLOCKER: Must be resolved before v1.0 Launch.' and change its status to 'In Progress' if it is currently 'New'.

2. The 'Login button unresponsive on mobile Safari iOS 17' issue is falling behind schedule. Reassign it from bob.walker to carol.santos (who has more capacity this sprint). Update the due date on that issue to match the 'v1.0 Launch' milestone's due date (check the project's versions). Add a comment: 'Reassigned to carol.santos for immediate attention. Due date aligned with v1.0 Launch milestone.'

Login credentials: admin / Admin1234!
